title: Netflix Advertising for Small Businesses: What You Need to Know

facts.fact: Netflix's direct advertising sales typically involve minimum spends of $10,000 or more, according to the Adwave page.
facts.quote: Netflix's direct advertising sales operation requires working with agency partners and typically involves minimum spends of $10,000 or more.

facts.fact: The page states that direct Netflix campaign minimum spends range from $10,000 to $25,000 or more.
The page states that direct Netflix advertising CPMs range from $40 to $60.
facts.quote: CPMs (cost per thousand impressions) ranging from $40 to $60

facts.fact: Through Adwave's programmatic access, the stated low minimum spend starts at $30 a day.
facts.quote: Low minimum spend (start at $30 a day with Adwave)

facts.fact: The page states that programmatic Netflix CPMs can range from $35 to $50 depending on targeting.
facts.quote: CPMs that can range from $35 to $50, depending on targeting

facts.fact: Adwave states that campaigns can be started with a minimum of $50.
facts.quote: With Adwave, you can start campaigns at just $50

facts.fact: The page states that Netflix's ad-supported tier launched in late 2022.
facts.quote: Netflix's ad-supported tier launched in late 2022

facts.fact: The page says that as of 2024, Netflix reports over 40 million global users on ad-supported plans.
facts.quote: As of 2024, the platform reports over 40 million global users on ad-supported plans

facts.fact: The page lists Netflix's ad-supported tier monthly fee as $6.99, compared with $15.49 for the Standard plan.
facts.quote: Price-conscious consumers attracted by the lower monthly fee ($6.99 vs $15.49 for Standard)

facts.fact: The page states that Netflix's younger ad-tier audience is especially 18-34 year olds.
The page states that Netflix's ad load is approximately 4-5 minutes of ads per hour.
facts.quote: approximately 4-5 minutes of ads per hour

facts.fact: The page cites free ad-supported platforms such as Tubi and Pluto TV with CPMs of $15 to $25.
The page states that Tubi alone has more than 80 million monthly users.
facts.quote: Massive reach (Tubi alone has 80M+ monthly users)

facts.fact: The page's own comparison claims that AVOD platforms can reach three to four times as many viewers for the same spend as Netflix.
facts.quote: You can reach three to four times as many viewers for the same spend compared to Netflix.
